title: Certify the screened P104 source-chart shortcut misses the debt-free …
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Negative result, no new κ. Selected conditional κ stays `0.001672660197076918`.

On the prepared entrance `(T^{-1} x, y)` of the PR #3978 joint cut, deleting either Gram factor leaves the physical source equal to `F T^{-1} x`, not `F x`. Local row and column FULL charts inside `F81 = F_2^9 ⊗ F_2^9` meet in one line and span 17 dimensions (codimension 64), checked for all `511 × 511` nonzero pairs. The rank-one chart tariff on all `N = 104^2 = 10816` data positions equals the debt-free allowance `C < 10816`, so the screened bill equals capacity `81 W = 2965248` before any further nonnegative charge. The strict gate fails.

This is not a fused caller, not a supplier, and not a universal P104 barrier. The inherited positive-debt excess 832 is only retied.

## Task and overlap

Item 6 of the chronological open-handoff list below. Base `bb4bccbf42844d2801487450727c2f63e10d1d0f`, priority revision 6. Card `p104-side-correction`, scope **refined**.

Handoff: discussion #1166 comment 19035513 (canonical note on PR #3954). Predecessor gate and `K = T^{-1}` tariff: PR #3978 head `48e2e44d8785be8204d8c4b719850332f4f9abe0`, package `research/p104-joint-compensation`. That head is not an ancestor of main, so it is cited rather than byte-pinned.

Nearest overlap, and why this is distinct:

- #4136 proves uniform completion misses a port-dependent chart. It does not expand the Gram product or compare the debt-free allowance with an `N`-position chart tariff.
- #4125 audits the index-to-tensor bridge. Its rank-10816 figure is the rational rank of an omitted identity side, not this chart tariff.
- #3978 prices a three-layer joint word at 32448 rank-one transforms. This note prices the one-axis shortcut that leaves `K` in place.

Ordered eligible list used for this session. Chronological smallest next tasks on #1166, after dropping a task a later DONE or an open PR already performs, and after dropping this account's round through #4149 (including the excluded #3942 re-audit and the superseded integer `log_q` coefficient 34). The full `(7,18)` census in comment 19021170 is deferred by the family-status resource rule and is not in this list. Comment 19034741 restates the same pair as 19034676 and is not counted twice.

1. T488 composed ownership/output invoice (comment 19022532, question 1). Question 2 is #3796.
2. Physical rank-8/u2 contract for the 16-extra rank-one residual (comment 19029639).
3. Downstream consumer of `(w, q, v_N)` (comment 19030045).
4. Adjacent six-tape event after #3932 event 9894 (comment 19030049), distinct from #4114.
5. Changed-gate chronological row/column pair and fiber tags (comment 19034676), distinct from #4131 and from the uniform-completion negatives #4133, #4136 and #4140.
6. This screened source-normalization shortcut (comment 19035513).

Overlap helper at 2026-10-20T03:21:48Z covered 842 open PR bodies with complete pagination. Discussion coverage was complete for the cached snapshot (2670 records). No matches is not claimed as novelty.

## Validation

CPython 3.12.3, standard library:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-source-chart-shortcut
```

Recorded result: `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/p104-source-chart-shortcut outcome=negative-result` and `PASS_P104_SOURCE_CHART_SHORTCUT checks=3 controls=5 span=17 codimension=64 cost=10816 allowance=10816 bill=2965248`.

Five mutants: the zero row vector, a truncated chart that does not span 17, an entrance that drops `K`, an off-by-one tariff that would pass the strict inequality, and a swapped `K F` word. Not run: native replay of #3978, Lean, Docker, and any fused-caller construction.

New census, expansion and gate comparison by unpaidmoon with Grok assistance in Cursor. Apache-2.0. No human or proof-assistant review is claimed.

## Open next questions

A producer whose source bank is already `F x`, rather than `F T^{-1} x`, is not ruled out. See `research/p104-source-chart-shortcut/README.md`. The smallest follow-up is one literal bank at the #3978 cut with owners, dirty returns and a bill strictly under `81 W` after every nonnegative charge. Paying `N` extra rank-one children for `T` on this shortcut does not create that margin.
